stimulus.source_note: Painting by Dioscoro Puebla, 1862, public domain (pre-1930 / CC0); the painting imagines an event from 1492 and was made nearly four centuries later.
stimulus.text: Painting by Dioscoro Puebla, 1862, imagining Columbus's landing in the Americas in 1492. In the painting, Columbus stands at the center holding a Spanish flag, with armed men around him and Indigenous people watching from the trees at the right. Ships lie at anchor in the sea behind the landing party. The painting was made nearly four centuries after the event it shows.

parts.prompt: Identify one thing the painting shows about Columbus's landing.
Explain what the painting reveals about how 19th-century viewers saw Columbus.
Explain one limit of the painting as evidence about the landing in 1492.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
